notes.title: January Known Issue
notes.content:
Hello Soulkeepers!!

We'd like to address a known issue regarding the New Year's Buff on the German and French. 
Although the buff display is currently not visible, we want to assure you that the buff is active and working as intended.

**New Year's Buff Details:**
1. EXP gain increased by 200%
2. Gold gain increased by 100%
3. Item drop increased by 100%
4. Jewel Enhancement Success Rate increased by 300%

Rest assured that our development team is actively working to resolve the display matter on the 
German and French. In the meantime, feel free to enjoy the boosted benefits of the New Year's 
Buff as you embark on your adventures!

We appreciate your understanding and wish you continued joy in the new year!
